output.text: A very punctual snail arrived at the annual Spring Blossom Festival on February 1st, 2027—exactly on time. The crowd gasped. It had taken a full year to get here! "But how?" they asked. The snail sighed. "I followed the wrong calendar—my shell’s engraved with lunar cycles from a forgotten island." The audience paused. Then the snail added, grinning, "Still early for next year."
